tasks.label: C/C++: build active file
tasks.command: if [ "${fileExtname}" = ".cpp" ]; then c="g++"; else c="gcc"; fi; exe="${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}"; fnT() { if [ $1 -ge 1000 ]; then echo "$(($1/1000)).$(( ($1%1000)/100 ))s"; else echo "${1}ms"; fi; }; echo -e "\e[36m▶\e[0m Building \e[1m${fileBasename}\e[0m \e[90m($c)\e[0m"; start_t=$(date +%s%3N); out=$($c -fdiagnostics-color=always -g "${file}" -o "$exe" 2>&1); bexit=$?; end_t=$(date +%s%3N); bms=$((end_t - start_t)); if [ -n "$out" ]; then echo "$out"; fi; w=$(echo "$out" | grep -ic "warning:"); e=$(echo "$out" | grep -ic "error:"); if [ $bexit -eq 0 ]; then sz=$(du -h "$exe" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1); echo -e "\e[32m✓ build ok\e[0m  \e[90min $(fnT $bms) · $w warn · $sz\e[0m"; else echo -e "\e[31m✗ build failed\e[0m  \e[90min $(fnT $bms) · $e error(s) · $w warn\e[0m"; fi; exit $bexit
tasks.detail: Auto-selects gcc for .c and g++ for .cpp

tasks.label: C/C++: build and run active file
tasks.command: if [ "${fileExtname}" = ".cpp" ]; then c="g++"; else c="gcc"; fi; exe="${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}"; logDir="/home/notamitgamer/Documents/bsc/buildLog"; mkdir -p "$logDir"; ts=$(date +"%Y-%m-%d_%H-%m-%M_%S"); logFile="$logDir/buildLog_$ts.txt"; strip() { sed -r 's/\x1B\[([0-9]{1,3}(;[0-9]{1,3})*)?[mGK]//g'; }; log() { echo -e "$1"; echo -e "$1" | strip >> "$logFile"; }; fnT() { if [ $1 -ge 1000 ]; then echo "$(($1/1000)).$(( ($1%1000)/100 ))s"; else echo "${1}ms"; fi; }; ver=$($c --version | head -n 1); loc=$(wc -l < "${file}"); log "\e[90m$(date +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')  ·  ${loc} lines  ·  $ver\e[0m"; log "\e[36m▶\e[0m Building \e[1m${fileBasename}\e[0m \e[90m($c)\e[0m"; start_t=$(date +%s%3N); out=$($c -fdiagnostics-color=always -g "${file}" -o "$exe" 2>&1); bexit=$?; end_t=$(date +%s%3N); bms=$((end_t - start_t)); if [ -n "$out" ]; then log "$out"; fi; w=$(echo "$out" | grep -ic "warning:"); e=$(echo "$out" | grep -ic "error:"); if [ $bexit -eq 0 ]; then sz=$(du -h "$exe" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1); log "\e[32m✓ build ok\e[0m  \e[90min $(fnT $bms) · $w warn · $sz\e[0m"; else log "\e[31m✗ build failed\e[0m  \e[90min $(fnT $bms) · $e error(s) · $w warn\e[0m"; log "\e[90mlog: $logFile\e[0m"; exit 1; fi; log ""; log "\e[36m▶\e[0m Running \e[1m${fileBasenameNoExtension}\e[0m"; log "\e[90m──────────────────────────────────────────\e[0m"; rstart_t=$(date +%s%3N); "$exe" 2>&1 | tee >(strip >> "$logFile"); rexit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; rend_t=$(date +%s%3N); rms=$((rend_t - rstart_t)); log "\e[90m──────────────────────────────────────────\e[0m"; rm -f "$exe"; if [ $rexit -eq 0 ]; then rc="32"; else rc="31"; fi; log "\e[${rc}m■ exit $rexit\e[0m  \e[90min $(fnT $rms)\e[0m"; log "\e[90mlog: $logFile\e[0m"; { echo ""; echo "────── SOURCE ──────"; cat "${file}"; } >> "$logFile"; exit 0
tasks.detail: Builds, runs, compact status lines, full logging preserved
